newsitem.title: USA: Primark to buy Baseline Financial - NYT.
newsitem.headline: Primark to buy Baseline Financial - NYT.

text.p: Primark Corp is set to announce on Wednesday that it has bought Baseline Financial Services for $40 million in cash from Bowne & Co and Robert Patterson, Baseline's founder, the New York Times reported.
The newspaper said in its Wednesday edition that Primark, which expects to complete the deal within a month, plans to integrate its data products with those of Baseline.
It said Baseline provides financial information on more than 7,000 U.S. companies to investment managers to more than 450 client companies in North America, mostly institutional portfolio managers.
